headline.caveat: all-cash acquisition agreed Mar 2025; closed Nov 25, 2025 after the FTC ended its review

nature_md: SoftBank Group acquired Arm-server-CPU designer Ampere Computing for $6.5B in cash (agreed March 2025; closed November 25, 2025 — the task-force review by the FTC was halted, clearing the final obstacle). Sellers included Carlyle and Oracle, both long-time Ampere investors. Ampere became a wholly owned SoftBank subsidiary, slotting into Masayoshi Son's AI-compute stack alongside ~90%-owned Arm and the Stargate program — giving SoftBank a merchant CPU design house for AI data centers.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Cash acquisition consolidated onto SoftBank Group's balance sheet (goodwill + intangibles vs the $6.5B consideration); adds to the leverage-funded AI program alongside the OpenAI stake, Arm, and Stargate commitments.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Exit proceeds to Carlyle, Oracle, and other holders; Ampere's operating results consolidate into SoftBank from Nov 2025.

events.title: SoftBank completes $6.5B acquisition of Ampere Computing
